summary: Cullinan Therapeutics filed an 8-K furnishing a press release on initial Phase 1 OUTRACE clinical data for CLN-978 in rheumatoid arthritis and systemic lupus erythematosus, presented at the EULAR congress. The filing under Items 7.01 and 8.01 is a routine disclosure of clinical trial results, not a special situation. No acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, tender offer, going-private, restructuring, or other corporate event is involved. The data update is operational and lacks any transaction terms, board recommendations, or deal mechanics. Therefore, this is classified as a routine current report with no special situation.
